description: This is a shell script used for testing git log color decoration features. It configures git color settings, sets up test repositories, and verifies that decorations such as branch, tag, and stash colors are correctly displayed in log outputs.

methods.name: cmp_filtered_decorations
methods.description: A function that filters color codes from the git log output and compares it with expected output to verify correct color decoration.

methods.name: remove_replace_refs
methods.description: Removes replace refs in git to reset the state for tests involving replaced objects.
